answer_1.quote: ...We conduct assessments on the validation sets of four datasets: TriviaQA, Natural Questions, SQuAD-1. For assessment over the open-ended and challenging Meadow, we only use the more advanced model GPT-3.5-turbo...

answer_2.quote: ...We use multiple correctness functions, including the Rouge-L score, BERT similarity, and ChatGPT evaluation...

answer_3.quote: ...ChatGPT evaluation is calculated by prompting GPT-3.5-turbo with the question, reference, and generation; and asking it to evaluate the correctness of the generation...
